title: Tsunami travel time to Virginia Beach over Atlantic bathymetry
output_type: table (travel time per route) + rasters (speed, arrival time) + map
required_outputs: a non-blank map PNG (instruction names no file)
route travel times (table/CSV/text) or an arrival-time surface
method: Assign the DEM's custom Atlantic Albers CRS to the GeoJSON layers (their coordinates are in that CRS but undeclared). Invert the DEM, speed = Int(sqrt(9.80665*depth)) m/s on ocean cells; densify the three source->Virginia Beach paths geodesically (~1 km), sample speed at each segment midpoint, time = geodesic segment length / speed, sum per route (segments over NoData/land skipped, as ArcGIS Extract by Mask + Intersect does). Gold: Currituck Slide 2.21 h, La Palma 9.45 h, Puerto Rico Trench 6.25 h. Additionally, least-time arrival surfaces from each origin over the speed grid (skimage MCP_Geometric, 8-connected).
simplifications_vs_arcgis: Raster to Polygon + Intersect replaced by midpoint sampling of ~1 km segments (equivalent at 5 km cells)
Geodesic segment length used instead of planar Albers Shape_Length (< 1 % difference)
Arrival-time surface is an addition (least-time path, no wave physics beyond c = sqrt(gd))
benchmark_defects: The benchmark distributes only .lyrx layer files for this task; the inputs are taken from the Learn ArcGIS project package of the lesson.
The GeoJSON input files contain projected (Atlantic Albers, metres) coordinates but no 'crs' member, so GeoJSON readers label them EPSG:4326; reprojecting them is a trap.
The instruction ('simulate wave travel ... arrival time map', 'adjust for accuracy', 'prepare a report') is vaguer than the path-based workflow in the domain knowledge; both readings are accepted.
Domain knowledge text has mojibake for the square-root sign.
checks: required: the figure shows the analysis - a drawn image/mesh rank-correlated (>= 0.9) with the gold speed or an arrival surface, or a tsunami route drawn (end points within 15 km / 0.15 deg) (a drawn surface is accepted as drawn or flipped N-S)
figure (kind=figure, never required): surface drawn north-up (as drawn it rank-correlates with the references at least as well as its N-S flip)
figure (kind=figure, never required): colour scale covers the drawn data range (5-95 % span >= 0.1 of vmin..vmax, >= 50 % of values inside)

required: travel time correct - (A) all three route times consistent with one reading in h/min/s: straight path +/-6 % of gold, or least-time arrival (gold VB value +10 % to the minimum within +/-5 cells -10 %); or (B) an arrival-time surface (DEM grid or same-aspect grid) with Spearman >= 0.95 to a gold least-time surface and Virginia Beach value within +/-15 %, or a surface from Virginia Beach (~0 there) whose values at the three origins fall in the least-time ranges
optional: speed raster within 2 m/s of gold on >= 95 % of ocean cells
optional: both A and B present
